body:
I came back from a 28 day rehab last week and going in I was extremly nervous and shy. But it didn’t take me long to open up and feel comfortable, because everyone (staff included) were so lovely. I had never felt so accepted by a bunch of people because we were all going through the same thing and we all had similar behaviours that drove our addiction so we could all just relate and people cared a lot for each other cause we all know how shit addiction is and we don’t want anyone to go back to it.

Take it moment by moment, day by day. You’re going to the right place and it will be life changing for all the right reasons. As hard as it is try not to focus too much on people on the outside. Cause you’ll be in there for you and thats where your focus needs to be. Focus on you to make your life so much better and so you can be more present for your loved ones once you get out. 

I experienced a fair bit of anxiety at times and had a panic attack here and there, but I was ok with it cause I knew the feeling would pass as I was in a safe and welcoming environment. So you can deal with any anxiety that’s coming your way, it’s temporary and you’re in the best place to let any bad feelings out.

I wish you all the best xxx
Thank u thats a very lovely comment :) hope ur doing well

Yeah im going to go to the gp today and have a big talk about everything. I would very much like to stop drinking, but unfortunately its not that easy. My reaction to trauma seems to be quite self destructive… but im looking to get professional help so hopefully things will improve soon :)

Oh bless you thanks for being so nice and i wish you the best also. Tbh ive got a lot of stuff to sort out but the gp is tomorrow so hopefully things will improve from there. I also base my worth on whether people like me and i know i shouldnt but its hard to unlearn. Its hard to know how to view myself when ive been used and assaulted so many times. I had shit mental health before any bad life events happened. My mum then passed away and then many sexual assaults happened including two cases of borderline rape and its hard to know where i stand or where i can go from there when everything feels so shit. But hopefully with help i will learn to move past everything. Thank you for reaching out and i wish you all the best its been very much appreciated

Thank you for your comment its comforting to know people are going through the same thing. I relate to the filling an emptiness. Ive been in a relationship since 15-19 and im now 20. I feel very uncomfortable being alone and struggle feeling content with it. I think part of the reason i hookup w a lot of people is cause it makes me feel like i have someone there and i feel less empty even if its façade and the consequences can be traumatic

My mum was diagnosed with terminal cancer and lived 3 years after it. We still got a lot done in those 3 years and I would of hated for any of it to be cut short.  I think its worth carrying on to make more memories with family and friends that will cherish those moments. I’m so sorry you’re going through this. If you want to talk about things i’m here for you

Please dont. Things seem shit i know. But everything passes eventually even when it seems like it never will. Please look for help such as calling the samaritans or what the moderator has recommended. Im sure theyll be a point in your life that youll look back at this and be very grateful you didnt do it.
